output.summary: Most of the $14.5M shrink increase is in DSD categories (73%). It follows the April 2025 removal of receiving clerks in 41 stores. Shrink rose to 3.0% in those stores versus 1.7% in the 17 clerk stores. An independent audit found invoiced value exceeded counted value by 4.9%. A matched-control pilot cut DSD shrink from 4.4% to 1.9% at modest cost. Count-firm artifact and associate-theft explanations are contradicted. District 4's bag checks recovered almost nothing, and its discrepancy-as-theft memo suppressed shortage claims. Organized crime and urban shrink are real but small, and confounded by self-checkout and turnover. Locked cases lose more margin than they save. Reinstating receiving is the preferred action. Cameras and LP officers are premature.
